name: Daniels VDOT
description: Jack Daniels and James Gilbert's oxygen-cost and %VO2max curves: your nearest result sets a VDOT, and that VDOT sets the time at the target distance. Built for 3-minute to 4-hour efforts, so use it from the 1500 m up.
trained_on: Daniels, J. T. & Gilbert, R. (1979), Oxygen Power: Performance Tables for Distance Runners. Published equations, no dataset. The range (log-SD 0.035, wider with distance) is a rough default, not fitted.
